capabilities: Analyze vault links with betweenness, PageRank, community detection, and component analysis
Visualize the vault graph with force-directed, hierarchical, radial, and circular layouts
Filter and color notes by tags, folders, recency, and structural criteria
Diagnose orphaned notes, broken links, isolated clusters, and scattered communities
Replay vault growth on a timeline and trace paths between notes
extras: Full documentation with screenshots lives in an external Clew guide; requires Obsidian 1.12.0 or later and is verified on desktop and iPad mobile.
intentEvidence: Clew is a second, purpose-built graph view layered on top of your vault
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph is a single fixed view with one color scheme and no analysis beyond what you can eyeball.
summary: Graph view with analytics that runs centrality, community detection, and diagnostics on vault links, with filters, coloring, and multiple layouts.
